# function rations density check set up 

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# ==========================================
# 1. CREATE MOCK METADATA (elements_data)
# ==========================================
# This maps the specific bone elements to their broad anatomical sections.
elements_data <- tibble::tribble(
  ~ElementsOne, ~Skeleton_Section,
  "cranium",    "cranium",
  "mandible",   "cranium",
  "isolated_t", "teeth",
  "cervical",   "vertebrae",
  "thoracic",   "vertebrae",
  "rib",        "thorax",
  "scapula",    "shoulder",
  "humerus",    "arms",
  "radius",     "arms",
  "carpal",     "hands",
  "pelvis",     "pelvic",
  "femur",      "legs",
  "tibia",      "legs",
  "tarsal",     "foot"
)

# ==========================================
# 2. CREATE MOCK WIDE DATA (taph_wide_df)
# ==========================================
# Rows are sites, columns are bone abundances (e.g., %MAU from 0 to 100)
taph_wide_df <- tibble::tribble(
  ~site_id, ~cranium, ~mandible, ~isolated_t, ~cervical, ~thoracic, ~rib, ~scapula, ~humerus, ~radius, ~carpal, ~pelvis, ~femur, ~tibia, ~tarsal,
  "Site_A",      100,       100,         100,       100,       100,  100,      100,      100,     100,     100,     100,    100,    100,     100,
  "Site_B",       90,        85,          95,        60,        50,   80,       20,       15,       5,       0,      10,      5,      0,       0,
  "Site_C",       10,        10,           5,        10,        10,   10,       80,       90,      85,       0,      95,     90,     80,      10
)
```



```{r}
# ==========================================
# 3. THE FUNCTIONS
# ==========================================

# Helper Function
build_taphonomic_groups <- function(elements_data, exclude_sections = c()) {
  valid_elements <- elements_data %>% filter(!Skeleton_Section %in% exclude_sections)
  ALL_COLUMNS <- unique(valid_elements$ElementsOne)
  GROUPS <- split(valid_elements$ElementsOne, valid_elements$Skeleton_Section)
  return(list(columns = ALL_COLUMNS, groups = GROUPS))
}

# The Main Feature Engineering Function
compute_engineered_features_simple <- function(taph_wide_df, elements_data, exclude_sections = c()) {
  
  schema <- build_taphonomic_groups(elements_data, exclude_sections)
  ALL_COLUMNS <- schema$columns
  GROUPS <- schema$groups
  
  available_cols <- intersect(ALL_COLUMNS, names(taph_wide_df))
  base_df <- taph_wide_df %>% select(site_id, all_of(available_cols))
  
  # Helper for standard arithmetic mean
  mean_abundance <- function(df, cols) {
    valid_cols <- intersect(cols, names(df))
    if(length(valid_cols) == 0) return(rep(NA, nrow(df)))
    rowMeans(df[, valid_cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  # Helper for Harmonic mean (Chain continuity)
  harmonic_mean_row <- function(df, cols) {
    valid_cols <- intersect(cols, names(df))
    if(length(valid_cols) == 0) return(rep(NA, nrow(df)))
    
    apply(df[, valid_cols, drop = FALSE], 1, function(x) {
      x <- x[!is.na(x) & x > 0] 
      if(length(x) == 0) return(0)
      length(x) / sum(1/x)
    })
  }

  out <- data.frame(site_id = base_df$site_id)
  epsilon <- 0.01 # Prevent division by zero
  
  # 1. Regional Composite Means 
  for (section_name in names(GROUPS)) {
    out[[paste0(section_name, "_Composite_Mean")]] <- mean_abundance(base_df, GROUPS[[section_name]])
  }
  
  # 2. Macro-Regions 
  axial_sections <- c("cranium", "teeth", "hyoid", "vertebrae", "thorax")
  appendicular_sections <- c("shoulder", "arms", "hands", "pelvic", "legs", "foot")
  
  axial_cols <- unlist(GROUPS[names(GROUPS) %in% axial_sections])
  appendicular_cols <- unlist(GROUPS[names(GROUPS) %in% appendicular_sections])
  
  out$Axial_Mean <- mean_abundance(base_df, axial_cols)
  out$Appendicular_Mean <- mean_abundance(base_df, appendicular_cols)
  out$Appendicular_to_Axial_Ratio <- (out$Appendicular_Mean + epsilon) / (out$Axial_Mean + epsilon)
  
  # 3. Chain Continuity
  upper_chain_cols <- unlist(GROUPS[names(GROUPS) %in% c("shoulder", "arms", "hands")])
  lower_chain_cols <- unlist(GROUPS[names(GROUPS) %in% c("pelvic", "legs", "foot")])
  
  out$Upper_Chain_Continuity <- harmonic_mean_row(base_df, upper_chain_cols)
  out$Lower_Chain_Continuity <- harmonic_mean_row(base_df, lower_chain_cols)

  return(out)
}
```



```{r}
# ==========================================
# 4. RUN THE TEST
# ==========================================

# Test 1: Include everything
cat("\n--- TEST 1: All Elements Included ---\n")
results_all <- compute_engineered_features_simple(
  taph_wide_df = taph_wide_df, 
  elements_data = elements_data, 
  exclude_sections = c()
)
glimpse(results_all)

# Test 2: Exclude teeth
cat("\n--- TEST 2: Exclude 'teeth' section ---\n")
results_no_teeth <- compute_engineered_features_simple(
  taph_wide_df = taph_wide_df, 
  elements_data = elements_data, 
  exclude_sections = c("teeth")
)

# Notice how "teeth_Composite_Mean" disappears from the output!
glimpse(results_no_teeth)

```
